execution.objective: Specify a recurring monthly repository hygiene cycle that reviews candidates, reports a cleanup recommendation list, and permanently removes only items satisfying the approved eligibility rules.
success_criteria: Review current repository state and classify candidates before cleanup on each monthly run.
Produce a dated report and machine-readable register containing the full recommended cleanup list and evidence.
Permanently delete only listed items verified as non-production and more than 90 days old, with reliable evidence for both conditions.
Exclude production, current, uncertain, protected, active, referenced, or recovery-relevant artifacts from automatic deletion.
Schedule the review-and-cleanup run for the last calendar day of every month in Asia/Singapore time.
Record the run result and every deleted path in durable cycle evidence.
Do not execute existing broad cleanup scripts.
Make no Builder, runtime, database, Supabase, or deployment changes.
proposed_outputs: A last-day-of-month schedule definition and run-evidence location
execution.verification_profile: MONTHLY_SCHEDULE; PRODUCTION_EXCLUSION; STRICT_90_DAY_AGE_GATE; REVIEW_BEFORE_CLEANUP; RECOMMENDATION_REGISTER; DELETION_AUDIT_TRAIL

cleanup_eligibility.age_rule: Delete only when reliable creation evidence proves the artifact is more than 90 days old at run time.
cleanup_eligibility.approval_model: The approved recurring WCS authorizes the eligible list as a whole; no per-item approval is required.

unlocks: A separately reviewed WCS to materialize and activate the scheduled recurring process.

proposed_surface_if_approved: A last-day-of-month schedule definition and run-evidence location
forbidden_surface: Artifacts with unknown production status, creation date, ownership, references, or recovery value
Runtime, database, Supabase, and deployment changes

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A current monthly review report identifies exact eligible candidates or records that none qualify.
